display_name: gdn postconv mtp bf16 state fp32
description:
Post-convolution GDN decode/MTP: packed BF16 QKV and raw gates feed QK normalization, decay/beta gates, recurrence and gated RMSNorm. Writes caller output and every indexed FP32 checkpoint, selecting the source state from the accepted-token count. D=128 with value/key head ratios 2/3 and the additional H4/HV32 ABI geometry. Convolution and its rolling history are outside this boundary.

Production entry: vllm fused_gdn_decode_post_conv_mtp; fixed source revision source-package-sha256:1b76cf9d38c8fe0a05a33d6a6267d92fc0def141a193e392b2324091687bc7d0.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Pool capacity is independent of active requests; reserve slot 0 and distinct destination/checkpoint slots. Inactive requests and arbitrary slot padding remain supported. Q/K heads=16/TP; value/state heads=16*head_ratio/TP; state per slot is [value_heads,128,128]. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: State matrices retain [Hv,128,128] and production strides, offsets and shared backing. Normal carried states now come from 32 previous valid tokens with fixed layer A_log/bias and the declared GDN per-head or KDA per-channel decay recurrence, FP32 between stores and actual state dtype at checkpoints. Synthetic raw projections have channel/head gains and AR(1) coefficient .5. Conv history and the current request are contiguous windows of that same process; candidate checkpoint j and convolution accepted-prefix shift refer to the same past endpoint. This is generated history, not captured model data. Existing tiny/zero/saturation/cancellation cases retain their stress construction. Pool capacity and physical slot pattern are independent input parameters, not inferred from request count or candidate width. Slot0/null semantics and unused storage guards remain.

defined_outputs.outputs_and_state: Same supplied contiguous BF16 out[T,HV,128] object returned; all positive destination checkpoints updated in-place. Slot0, gaps, guards and unused slots unchanged.

validation.correctness_scope: Original library, validation_scope=sampled, SM103; fixed shape IDs 0-9, at most 2 recorded seeds per shape. 采样通过. Counts={'passed': 20}. No prior patched results inherited. Shared-GPU timings are execution checks only.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
